messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High tail latency detected for /v1/generate (prod, us-west-2)
incidents-bot: Summary: 99th percentile latency > 5s for 2m, error-rate spike on model-serving nodes. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/serve-high-tail-latency
sara (oncall): ack — I'm on it. grabbing context and checking customer impact.
sara (oncall): checking dashboards now, will post quick findings.
incidents-bot: New alert fired: serve.high_tail_latency.v1_generate (threshold=5s, window=60s).
nate (sre): @sara I see elevated KV cache miss rate on gpu-pool-a, looks like an eviction storm. CPU on routing proxies also higher than usual.
sara (oncall): copying logs from proxy ingress: ```curl -s http://proxy-metrics/api/metrics | jq '.requests | .[] | select(.path=="/v1/generate")'``` gave lots of 429s from backends.
marco (platform): we're seeing ~30% of requests falling back to cpu-quantized model; backend backpressure is happening. Scaling didn't kick because autoscaler threshold is tied to avg latency not p99.
frank (product-support): any sign of customer-facing errors? Support queue shows 6 new errors flagged as "requests timed out" in the last 10m. One trial customer reported UI spinner for >10s.
sara (oncall): impact: partial degradation, mostly tail latency causing timeouts. No full outage. Prioritize mitigation to reduce customer timeouts.
nate (sre): mitigation plan: 1) temporarily raise autoscaler sensitivity to p95 latency 2) enable regional fallback routing to us-east-1 for non-SLA traffic 3) reduce batch sizes for long-seq requests to reduce head-of-line blocking.
sara (oncall): doing 1) now. command: ```kubectl patch hpa serve-worker -n prod -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleUp":{"policies":[{"type":"Percent","value":100,"periodSeconds":60}]}}}}'```
sara (oncall): patched — scaling policy relaxing. watching metrics.
incidents-bot: autoscaler event: serve-worker scaled from 8 -> 16 pods at 2932101260.
marco (platform): enabling fallback routing for non-paid tier: ```/configs/routing set --policy fallback-region=us-east-1 --match 'tier!=enterprise'``` — applied.
frank (product-support): sending notice to affected customers in the trial bucket. ETA 10m.
adele (observability): I'm going to wire up a temporary dashboard tile with p50/p95/p99 for /v1/generate + kv-cache-hit-rate + proxy-429-rate. Add drilldowns to traces. I'll iterate here so we have view for the retro.
sara (oncall): agree. need that for post-incident notes.
adele (observability): created temp dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/incident/2932101111 — panels added: "Generate - latency percentiles", "KV cache hit/miss by pool", "Proxy 429/502 counts", "Model fallbacks by region". Added a drilldown on p99 to trace view.
ate (sre): nice. can you add a golden-signals summary panel (latency/error/saturation) + link to service-level playbook?
adele (observability): done. golden signals panel added with templated var for region and model type. Also added link button to runbook.
marco (platform): we should tune alerting after we stabilize. current alert fires on short blips. Suggest change: alert on p99 > 5s sustained for 3m AND error-rate > 1% in same window. Also split the alert into two severities: WARNING for p95>2s, SEVERE for p99>5s + errors.
sara (oncall): +1 on separation. Right now noisy paging is making oncall fatigue worse.
nate (sre): I'd also add condition that model fallback rate > 10% to avoid scale-only triggers when model warmups are happening.
frank (product-support): can we expose a simple status page snippet so customers see degraded mode when fallback routing is active?
marco (platform): yes — toggling maintenance flag for non-enterprise traffic will show "degraded performance" on status.redwood.ai. Doing that now.
incidents-bot: maintenance-mode set for trial bucket at 2932101422.
adele (observability): quick note on dashboard drilldowns: use this query for traces drilldown (Grafana/Tempo): ```service="serve" AND http.path="/v1/generate" AND duration>5000``` — that surfaces head-of-line traces. Also added a panel with example slow-request spans.
sara (oncall): mitigation progress: tail latency p99 down from 8.2s -> 3.1s after scaling + fallback. Error-rate trending down. I'll keep monitoring for 15m.
nate (sre): confirmed. Also patched the worker JVM GC config on 2 pods to test lower pause times — no regressions so far.
frank (product-support): update: support queue volume stabilized, customers updated.
sara (oncall): marking incident as "mitigated" for now. We'll do a full post-incident with retro and alert tuning.
incidents-bot: Incident 2932101111 status changed: MITIGATED at 2932101600 by sara (oncall).
adele (observability): for the retro/dashboard workstream: proposal to persist the temporary dashboard as "incidents/serve-high-tail-latency" and add canonical panels: 1) Golden signals summary 2) P50/P95/P99 by model & region 3) KV cache heatmap (per pool) 4) Proxy error breakdown with drilldown to logs 5) Model-fallback-rate with correlate to quantized model traffic.
adele (observability): I'll open a PR with the dashboard JSON and a README describing each panel + recommended thresholds. tagging @marco @nate for review.
marco (platform): please also include variables: region, model_variant, and customer_tier so oncall can quickly filter.
adele (observability): done — variables included in the draft.
sara (oncall): action items before close: 1) adele to post dashboard PR 2) nate to update alert rules (split severities + sustained-window requirement) 3) marco to adjust autoscaler to use p95 fallback plus queue depth metric 4) frank to circulate customer impact summary to sales & support.
frank (product-support): on it — will post a 1-paragraph summary to #customer-notices and tag accounts.
nate (sre): I'm going to draft the alert-rule changes now. Proposed rule snippet: ```- alert: ServeHighTailLatency
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="serve"}[3m])) by (le)) > 5
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "Serve service p99 latency > 5s (3m)"```
sara (oncall): that looks good. make sure we also add an annotation to call out model-fallback rate condition.
nate (sre): will do.
adele (observability): PR opened: https://git.redwood/dashboards/pulls/142 — includes panels, drilldowns, thresholds suggestions. Please review.
incidents-bot: Incident 2932101111 status changed: RESOLVED at 2932101745 (duration 634s).
sara (oncall): great job team. We'll run the retro tomorrow: 10:00 PT — main items: alert tuning, autoscaler policy change, dashboard persistence + runbook updates.
frank (product-support): I'll bring customer timeline.
marco (platform): I'll add the autoscaler tweak to the deploy checklist so future scale-ups react to p95.
adele (observability): after the retro I'll convert the incident dashboard to a template and add it to the "post-incident" dashboard folder so it's easy to clone.
sara (oncall): closing thread here. If anyone finds follow-ups, add to the PR or create tickets and mention #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:
